new_result.statement: For A_a=[[a,sqrt(1+a),0],[sqrt(1+a),0,0],[0,0,1]], 0<a<=1/3, spectrum {1+a,-1,1}, and independent Uniform[0,1] inputs, the scalar-square absolute half-Riesz interface H(a)=a^{-1/2} E|X_2^2-((1+a)/a)X_1^2|^{-1/2} obeys H(a)>=(1/sqrt(1+a))*log(sqrt((1+a)/a)/2), hence diverges logarithmically as a downarrow0 while the actual output density remains uniformly bounded by the prior fixed-principal-triple theorem.
new_result.scope: Mechanism counterexample only; not a QFORM counterexample.
